instruction.name: movfr2gr.s
instruction.description: Sign-extend the low 32 bits of fj into rd.

experiments.name: high-unroll memory-assisted chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 0' --asm 'movfr2gr.s $r4, $f0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5; st.d $r4, $r12, 0; fld.d $f0, $r12, 0'
experiments.notes: 11.05-cycle chain minus 8.06 cycles (7.06 GPR-store -> FPR-load forwarding + 1 add.d) = 2.99 cycles. Measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 gave 2.86 because per-call overhead was not fully amortised.

latencies.notes: FPR -> GPR latency is 3 cycles. The full movgr2fr.d + movfr2gr.d round trip is 4 cycles; inserting fadd or fmul changes it by exactly the inserted latency, so the round trip is additive. This rules out a 3+2 split for the .d/.w/.s moves.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movfr2gr.s $r12, $f0; movfr2gr.s $r13, $f1; movfr2gr.s $r14, $f2; movfr2gr.s $r15, $f3; movfr2gr.s $r16, $f4; movfr2gr.s $r17, $f5; movfr2gr.s $r18, $f6; movfr2gr.s $r19, $f7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'movfr2gr.s $r12, $f0; movfr2gr.s $r13, $f1; movfr2gr.s $r14, $f2; movfr2gr.s $r15, $f3; movfr2gr.s $r16, $f4; movfr2gr.s $r17, $f5; movfr2gr.s $r18, $f6; movfr2gr.s $r19, $f7'

notes: Individual FPR->GPR latency is 3 cycles. Round trip with movgr2fr.d is 4 cycles; high-half round trip movgr2frh.w + movfrh2gr.s is 5 cycles. 3+2 cycles for movgr2fr/movfr2gr is incompatible with the 4-cycle full round trip. Throughput is 1 CPI for 1-20 independent lanes.
